title: pleopeltis sanctae-rosae
intro: Pleopeltis sanctae-rosae, commonly known as the "Santa Rosa resurrection fern," is a species of epiphytic fern native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis sanctae-rosae include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antihypertensive properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
